description: List the vault's work pile: `task`-type concepts with their lifecycle (open/taken/done), oldest first, including who has taken each one (takenBy). Filter by taskStatus or by the domain the tasks are part_of. Read-only; take_task is what claims a task.

domain.description: Only tasks that are part_of this domain concept id.

taskStatus.description: Only tasks in this lifecycle state ("open" | "taken" | "done"). Omit for all.

name: list_tasks
title: List tasks
